title: Hypergraph Embedding Indexing for Efficient Dense Vector Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.22980v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dense vector retrieval has become the foundation of modern semantic search, yet existing approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) indexes treat an embedding as an indivisible point in a high-dimensional space. In this work, we propose the Hypergraph Embedding Index (HEI), a framework that instead organizes documents according to combinations of highly activated latent embedding dimensions. This formulation enables inverted-index style candidate generation while preserving the semantic ranking capabilities of dense embeddings. We further demonstrate that constructing multiple complementary hypergraphs substantially improves retrieval coverage without the combinatorial growth associated with increasing the dimensionality of a single hypergraph. Finally, we establish that the statistical properties of embedding activations strongly influence coordinate-inverted indexing efficiency, introducing \emph{activation diversity} as a diagnostic metric

translated_title: 超图嵌入索引用于高效稠密向量检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22980v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：稠密向量检索已成为现代语义搜索的基础，然而现有的近似最近邻（ANN）索引将嵌入视为高维空间中的不可分割点。在这项工作中，我们提出了超图嵌入索引（HEI），这是一种根据高度激活的潜在嵌入维度组合来组织文档的框架。该公式能够实现倒排索引风格的候选生成，同时保留稠密嵌入的语义排序能力。我们进一步证明，构建多个互补超图能显著提高检索覆盖率，而不会出现因增加单个超图维度而带来的组合爆炸式增长。最后，我们确定嵌入激活的统计特性对坐标倒排索引效率有强烈影响，引入了“激活多样性”作为诊断指标。
tldr: 提出超图嵌入索引（HEI）框架，通过组合高激活嵌入维度组织文档，利用多超图互补提升检索覆盖率，并引入激活多样性指标优化索引效率。
en_tdlr: Proposed the Hypergraph Embedding Index (HEI) framework that organizes documents by combinations of highly activated embedding dimensions, uses complementary hypergraphs to boost retrieval coverage, and introduces activation diversity as a diagnostic metric for indexing efficiency.
